concept_prompt: A compact brushed-steel cylindrical weight hangs from one tightly wound steel helical spring whose top end is hooked to the horizontal crossbar of a rigid dark walnut and black-steel frame. The full spring, both of its hooked ends, the weight, and the frame are visible in a straight-on side view. At the first frame the weight is pulled about one centimetre below its resting position and released; it bobs gently straight up and down, the spring coils evenly stretching and compressing, with each oscillation slightly smaller than the last. The weight does not swing sideways or rotate, the spring keeps the same number of coils and stays connected at both ends, the frame is perfectly still.
